question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'option 3'** i.e.** "explored".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, the term** "explored" **is most fitting because **it refers to** the act of examining or investigating a location, in this case, the ocean floor.
 
• The **sentence is saying that** we have less knowledge and investigation about the ocean floor compared to the surface of Mars.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *The ocean floor is famously less** explored** than the surface of Mars. And when our team of scientists recently mapped the seabed, and ancient sediments beneath, we (2)______ what looks like an asteroid impact crater. Intriguingly, the crater, (3)______ “Nadir” after the nearby volcano Nadir Seamount, is of the same age as the Chicxulub impact caused by a huge asteroid at the end of the Cretaceous (4)______, around 66 million years ago, which (5)______ the dinosaurs and many other species.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's consider the other options:
 
 
• **"Reconstructed" **generally means to build or form (something) again after it has been damaged or destroyed. It does not fit here because the sentence is about the examination or investigation of the ocean floor, not about building it again.
 
• **"Imposed" **usually refers to force (something unwelcome or unfamiliar) to be accepted or put in place. This doesn't fit in the given context.
 
• **"Stocked"** means to have or keep a supply of (a particular product or type or product) available for sale. This also doesn't make sense in this context.
